description: This file is a Perl script for flashing firmware onto D-Link DSL-G6x4T devices. It includes device probing, FTP communication, and firmware transfer functionalities.

classes.name: ADAM2FTP
classes.description: A custom subclass of Net::FTP with additional methods for interacting with the ADAM2 device, including environment variable retrieval and reboot functionality.

methods.name: _USER
methods.description: Sends a USER command to the FTP server.

methods.name: _GETENV
methods.description: Retrieves an environment variable from the FTP server.

methods.name: getenv
methods.description: Public method to get an environment variable.

methods.name: _REBOOT
methods.description: Sends a reboot command to the FTP server.

methods.name: reboot
methods.description: Public method to reboot the device.
